name: Dorfstube
beschreibung:
Set in the heart of the scenic Pillersee valley, Gasthof Dorfstube in Fieberbrunn welcomes guests with authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Lovingly furnished guest rooms and hearty local cuisine ensure a delightful stay.

With easy access to the world-class Skicircus and spectacular mountain bike and hiking trails across the Kitzbuehel Alps, it is an ideal choice for active nature enthusiasts.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Dorfstube in Fieberbrunn offers alpine charm and immediate proximity to the vast Skicircus Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn.
